subject: tests/db/test_migrations.py round trip fails on shared: 0024's downgrade cannot parse 0026's agent_health_kind_check (builds 'check (kind in ())')
body: Downgrading from head: 0026 (S22) rebuilds agent_health_kind_check as 'kind = any (%L::text[])'. 0024's DOWNGRADE (S21) then reads the constraint text with regexp_matches(defn, '''([a-z_]+)''') and finds nothing in the array form, so it executes 'alter table public.agent_health add constraint agent_health_kind_check check (kind in ())' -> syntax error. Fails test_round_trip_from_empty, test_downgrade_refuses_to_drop_non_empty_buckets and test_concurrent_upgrades_serialise_on_the_advisory_lock locally on a fresh stack (independent of S15's 0028, which does not touch agent_health). Suggest one shared helper both use (read kinds via a regex that also matches the array literal, or pg_get_constraintdef + unnest). Not touching either file.
